method_notes: Council (Achieving for Children) measures home-to-school distance in metres as the shortest route by road and/or maintained footpath using the School Admissions GIS and Ordnance Survey data. Start: OS address/seed point within the property (route joins nearest road centre; all flats in a block share one point). End: nearest named (pedestrian) school gate or nodal point designated in the school's admission arrangements. Excludes routes through car parks, parks, cemeteries, private paths etc.; council says these are not promoted as actual walking routes. Exceptions per council guide (2026 and 2027 entry): Deer Park, St Elizabeth's Catholic Primary, Thomson House and Twickenham Primary Academy measure in a straight line from the seed point to school-designated gate(s). Faith schools (VA/Catholic academies) allocate many places by faith/parish criteria first. Sources: Richmond primary guide 2027 entry (Sep 2026) and 2026 entry; Admission arrangements for Richmond community schools 2027/28.
